_meta.description: Heart event #6 for npc_michelle: In the Greenhouse

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The greenhouse, evening. Michelle is tending flowers]

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Oh! J-Jack. I didn't hear you come in.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I was just... the lavender needs — actually, that's a lie.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I know exactly what's wrong with me.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: You built me this greenhouse. You carried the glass panels yourself.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: You spent three days on the heating system.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: No one has ever done something like that for me.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: I've spent my whole life taking care of everyone else.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: And I never thought to ask for anything for myself.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Stay. Just... stay. Not as the engineer. Not as my friend.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: As... more. I want more. Is that selfish?

options.text: It's the bravest thing I've ever heard you say.
I've been wanting to hear you say that.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Really? You're not just being nice?

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Oh no. I'm crying in my greenhouse. This is so embarrassing.
